description: For an address with prefix or mask (192.168.1.10/24, 10.0.0.5 255.255.255.0, 2001:db8::/32): network, broadcast, first and last host, host count, netmask, wildcard and binary; optional split into smaller subnets or the smallest subnet for N hosts. Several addresses per call, one per line. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/subnet-calculator.

addresses.description: Addresses with prefix or mask, one per line

hostsNeeded.description: Hosts needed in one subnet, e.g. 50 (optional)

splitPrefix.description: Split into subnets of this prefix, e.g. 26 (optional)
